title: Search integrity and backend parity hardening
description: Implement the 2026-07-10 verified search hardening audit across FTS, JSON fallback, object-index coordination, health diagnostics, global search, daemon observation, docs, and regression coverage. Related existing targets: bw_work_a77c72fee51fe8c2, bw_work_3c962ef6c33a101d, bw_work_308d3ce46b880ea4, bw_work_f1500b41cca2c75c, bw_work_3cc50623d36aa119, and closed follow-up bw_work_76ef0067e2d2ec8f.
acceptanceCriteria: Healthy status validates the complete active artifact and never false-passes malformed SQLite or truncated JSON.
FTS and JSON expose the same result fields, type-filter behavior, multi-term semantics, snippets, and comparable global ranking scores.
Explain mode works with an active FTS workspace without parsing SQLite as JSON.
Search and dashboard failures remain distinguishable from an empty result set and retain actionable recovery details.
FTS rebuilds coordinate with incremental object-index writers, retry transient contention, and never silently downgrade a healthy-capable workspace to legacy JSON.
FTS schema ownership is single-sourced and versioned, query/document budgets are enforced, and symlinked cache paths fail closed.
Daemon paths, generated docs, CLI help, and FTS-active regression coverage match the current index architecture.
closedReason: All search integrity and backend parity acceptance criteria are implemented and verified; strict closeout's sole blocker is unrelated raw-source reconciliation.
